parameters.name: ConnectionStringPrefix
parameters.description:
The new connection string prefix. The prefix must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- It must be 6 to 30 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters in your account, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: DBEndpointId
parameters.description:
The ID of the connection address.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusterEndpoints](~~98205~~) operation to query the ID of a connection address.

parameters.name: NetType
parameters.description:
The network type of the connection address. Valid values:

- **Public**: public network

- **Private**: private network

<props="china">

- **Inner**: classic network

</props>

<props="china">

Only PolarDB for MySQL clusters support the classic network type.

</props>

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description:
The port number. The valid range is 3000 to 5999.

> - This parameter is supported only for PolarDB for MySQL clusters. If you do not specify this parameter, the port defaults to 3306.

parameters.name: PrivateZoneAddressPrefix
parameters.description:
The prefix of the private domain name. The prefix must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- It must be 6 to 30 characters in length.

> * You can bind a private domain name to each private endpoint of a PolarDB cluster. This domain name is effective only in the specified VPC within the current region. The private domain name is managed by PrivateZone and is mapped to the built-in private endpoint of the cluster through a CNAME record. This feature incurs a small fee. For more information, see [Pricing](~~71338~~).
>
> * This parameter is valid only when **NetType is set to Private**.

parameters.name: PrivateZoneName
parameters.description:
The private zone name.

> This parameter is valid only when **NetType is set to Private**.
